publisher: Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Skills Development
capture_method: Factual fields checked in official school profiles through the web tool, then saved locally. Page revision dates are unavailable. On 2026-10-24 every school profile in Faafu, Dhaalu, Gaafu Alifu and Gaafu Dhaalu was added (plus R. Vaadhoo and V. Thinadhoo, which share names with Gaafu Dhaalu schools); island_id is the Census island matching the profile's stated island.
coverage: Partial enrichment. A missing grade list means unknown, not that a school teaches no grades.

records.grade_evidence: Profile explicitly describes foundation stage through Grade 12. Numeric grades are expanded from that stated range; foundation is retained as a stage rather than inventing individual kindergarten grade offerings.

Profile states: "Faafu Atoll Education Centre is a K0 to K5 single session school" and "The school has Science and Business stream in both O Level and A level." A level is higher secondary (key stage 5), so K0 to K5 is read as foundation to key stage 5. Grades expanded with the National Curriculum Framework (NIE, 2014, Table 2; https://media.unesco.org/sites/default/files/webform/r2e002/2cda5a0a236191e565a7e98f824f23c08b5dad32.pdf): foundation = LKG/UKG, key stage 1 = grades 1-3, 2 = 4-6, 3 = 7-8, 4 = 9-10, 5 (higher secondary) = 11-12.
